data.name: A Festive Opening Is on the Way

content.slate:
{"type":"document","children":[{"type":"block-text","children":[{"text":"It’s beginning to feel a lot like Christmas at The Farmers Oak! 🎄

Behind the scenes, we’ve been busy preparing, making improvements and getting everything ready for what’s to come. We’re working towards opening The Farmers Oak fully to the public, and we can’t wait to welcome everyone through our doors.

There’s plenty happening, and this is just the beginning. We’re getting closer every day, and we look forward to sharing more updates, opening dates and what you can expect.

Thank you to everyone who has supported us so far. Keep an eye out, Christmas is coming, and so is The Farmers Oak!

More updates coming soon."}]}]}
